hero.title: Christmas Party Nights
hero.lede: Bring the office, the club or the whole street. A festive meal, music and dancing until late in our function suite, with rooms upstairs for anyone who'd rather not head home.

sections.title: Christmas party nights at Bentley Hotel
sections.html:
December is when Motherwell’s offices, clubs, teams and groups of friends gather to see the year out, and our function suite, the Back o’ Barns, is made for it. It seats up to 100 for dinner and holds up to 120 once the tables are cleared for dancing, and it is air-conditioned, which matters more than you’d think by the third song.

A party night here runs the way a good one should. Find your table, sit down to a three-course festive meal cooked in our own kitchen, and then the music starts and the floor fills. We can arrange the music, and we’ll talk through the licence when you book so you know how late the night can run. Ask about the licence if a late finish matters to your group.

Smaller groups join a shared party night, a good way for a team of eight or ten to have a big night out without hiring a room. Larger groups can ask about having the function suite to themselves. Nobody has to worry about getting home: parking is free, Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk, and our 18 en-suite rooms are upstairs, with breakfast cooked to order the next morning.

sections.title: The room, the meal and the morning after

items.title: The function suite
items.text: Air-conditioned, with room for up to 100 at dinner and 120 for the dancing. Shared nights for smaller groups; ask about exclusive use for larger ones.

items.title: The festive meal
items.text: Three courses cooked in our own kitchen, with choices collected in advance and dietary needs catered for. Menus are confirmed each autumn.

items.title: Stay over
items.text: Our 18 en-suite rooms are upstairs, so nobody has to find a taxi at the end of the night. Breakfast is cooked to order.

sections.title: Party nights: what organisers ask us

items.q: How do we book a Christmas party night?
items.a: Call us on 01698 265588 or send an enquiry with rough numbers and the dates that suit your group. We’ll confirm what is available and explain how to hold the booking.
Yes, we usually ask for a deposit to hold the date. We’ll explain the amount, when it is due and our cancellation terms when you book.

items.q: Can you cater for dietary requirements?
items.a: Yes. We’ll ask for menu choices from your group in advance, and that is the time to tell us about allergies, intolerances and vegetarian or vegan guests.

items.q: How late does the night go, and how do we get home?
items.a: We’ll explain the licence and the finishing time when you book. Parking is free, Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk, and our rooms are upstairs if anyone would rather stay the night.

sections.title: Book your Christmas party night
sections.text: Tell us your numbers and the dates that suit, and we’ll come back with what is available.
